description: This file implements the WebAudioPlayer class and related factory functions for managing Web Audio playback, including buffer management, state notifications, and IPC interactions within the Rialto client component.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayer
classes.description: Implements the WebAudioPlayer class responsible for managing audio playback, buffer handling, and IPC communication within the Rialto client.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the WebAudioPlayer instance, sets up IPC, and registers the client.

methods.name: ~WebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Destructor that unregisters the client and cleans up resources.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Signals end of stream to the IPC.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves available buffer frames and shared memory info.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes audio data to shared memory and notifies IPC.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device information such as preferred and maximum frames.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the client.

methods.name: notifyState
methods.description: Notifies the client of a state change.
